verdict.rationale: MLX is Apple's own array framework explicitly built for Apple silicon with unified-memory support (docs-21, docs-35), and Apple's Metal/ML developer docs document GPU Neural Accelerators, PyTorch backend acceleration, and Neural Engine support for on-device model inference (docs-10, docs-12, docs-26, docs-34). This directly satisfies 'vendor's own AI software stack documents support'. Missing for 10: explicit llama.cpp or ONNX Runtime documentation naming M4 Max support, and independent hands-on benchmarks of local LLM inference on this specific chip.
